Appraiser remarks
The vehicle presents a side impact to the driver's door and rear quarter panel, with
deformation concentrated lower on the body than the claimant's account would suggest,
and the dents sit on the opposite flank from the reported point of contact. The
proposed repair plan covers panel straightening, replacement of the rear door skin,
refinishing of adjacent panels for colour match, and recalibration of the door-mounted
sensor. Labor hours requested are consistent with the extent of the visible
deformation and the parts listed. Shop invoices show a single set of charegs with no
repeated line items. Inspection found no indication of prior collision repair or
unrelated older damage on the vehicle. The location and height of the dents should be
reviewed against the loss description before final approval.

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- duplicate_billing: Was the same service, visit or part billed twice? Allowed: None, Possible, Confirmed.
- labor_hours_plausibility: Are the repair labor hours plausible for the damage? Allowed: Plausible, Elevated, Excessive.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.

- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
